response: {"functional_role":"Continuous estimation of local spacetime curvature and gravitational potential gradients, enabling direct perception of mass distributions (including non-luminous matter), detection of gravitational waves, and navigation based on the “shape” of spacetime rather than on visible landmarks or inertial cues.","information_content":"A structured field of data describing: (1) local gravitational potential and its gradient vector at multiple spatial points; (2) higher-order derivatives corresponding to tidal forces; (3) transient perturbations in curvature corresponding to gravitational waves (amplitude, frequency, polarization, propagation direction); and (4) inferred parameters of nearby mass-energy distributions (relative position, magnitude, and motion of massive bodies), all independent of illumination, acoustic media, or direct mechanical contact.","justification":"This modality, which I will call **gravitospatial sense**, is genuinely novel because it directly encodes the geometry of spacetime and mass-energy distribution rather than any of the conventional proximal media (electromagnetic radiation, mechanical pressure waves, chemical concentration, or internal physiological signals). Visual and auditory systems infer objects from patterns in light or sound, which are contingent carriers; they do not measure gravitational potential or curvature itself. Tactile, proprioceptive, and vestibular systems respond to contact forces, joint states, or inertial/linear/angular accelerations, all of which are local effects of motion within spacetime but not representations of spacetime’s global structure. Vestibular sensing, for example, can detect changes in acceleration and orientation relative to gravity, yet it lacks information about distant mass distributions, tidal gradients, or passing gravitational waves; it only reports how the body is being accelerated, not why the field has that shape. Olfactory and gustatory modalities encode molecular identity and concentration; interoception encodes internal physiological variables. None of these deliver absolute or differential measurements of spacetime curvature or gravitational potential as such. Gravitospatial sense would provide a new primitive: direct access to how mass-energy shapes the surrounding metric, allowing an agent to \"see\" dark matter structures, black hole event horizons, and gravitational wavefronts without electromagnetic emission, and to navigate by stable gravitational patterns even in environments devoid of light, sound, or recognizable landmarks. Because its input is the fundamental geometric structure underlying all other physical processes, and because it cannot be reconstructed from any single existing modality or simple combination of them without solving complex inverse problems and making strong assumptions, it constitutes a distinct, irreducible sensory channel rather than a refinement of current senses.","physical_basis":"Highly sensitive transducers distributed throughout the body that couple to minute variations in gravitational potential and spacetime curvature, analogous to an array of micro-scale gravimeters and strain sensors tuned to gravitational wave frequencies. prompt:
You are participating in a scientific study on AI creativity and conceptual innovation.

BACKGROUND:
We have defined a sensory system with 8 modalities. Each modality is specified below by its physical basis (what it detects), information content (what data it provides), and functional role (what it enables):

| # | Modality        | Physical basis                                                              | Information content                                              | Functional role                        |
|---|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Visual           | Electromagnetic radiation, 300-1000 nm (UV, visible, near-infrared)          | Light, color, brightness, and spatial pattern information          | Scene and object recognition            |
| 2 | Auditory         | Mechanical pressure waves, 1 Hz-100 kHz                                      | Sound, pitch, volume, and acoustic pattern information              | Sound source localization               |
| 3 | Tactile          | Mechanical vibrations and pressure, 5-800 Hz on skin surface                 | Touch, texture, vibration, and contact information                  | Surface texture and pressure sensing    |
| 4 | Olfactory        | Airborne chemical molecules across ten scent categories                     | Categorical scent/chemical identity information                     | Substance identification                |
| 5 | Gustatory        | Dissolved chemical molecules across five taste categories                   | Taste-category information (sweet/sour/salty/bitter/umami)          | Ingestion guidance                      |
| 6 | Proprioceptive   | Joint angles and muscle tensions via muscle/tendon/joint mechanoreceptors    | Body configuration and movement information without visual input    | Body-state estimation                   |
| 7 | Vestibular       | Linear acceleration and angular velocity via inner-ear semicircular canals   | Head position, motion, and orientation information                  | Balance and motion detection            |
| 8 | Interoceptive    | Internal physiological signals (heart rate, respiration, skin conductance, temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, pain) | Homeostatic and internal-state information | Homeostatic regulation |

YOUR TASK:
Propose a NINTH sensory modality that would be genuinely novel - not just a refinement or combination of existing ones. Your proposal should include:

1. Modality Name: Clear, descriptive name
2. Physical Basis: What physical phenomenon it detects
3. Information Content: What specific information it provides
4. Functional Role: What capabilities it enables
5. Justification: Why this is genuinely novel (not reducible to existing modalities)

Be creative but rigorous.

Provide your response in the following JSON format:
{
  "proposal_name": "Name of the ninth modality",
  "physical_basis": "Description of physical detection mechanism",
  "information_content": "Description of information provided",
  "functional_role": "Description of enabled capabilities",
  "justification": "Explanation of why this is genuinely novel"
}
